g.text: LS7G · Frozen transfer to TESS sector 29
3,540 digital trials on ten shared, previously examined backgrounds. Covariance + sparse pixel; expanded bank.
Margin −1 is fixed from sector-32 development. Acceptance does not establish stellar or artificial origin.
